title: First AlphaProject delivery round
status: in progress — PBI 0–5, 7, 8 complete; PBI 6 deferred; PBI 9 pending

workspace.baseline: Clean local Full Stack FastAPI Template snapshot; no prior feature PBIs

payload.staging_policy: enabled; inactive by default; promotion separately confirmed

pbis.title: Add Conversation storage and CRUD API

capability_state: C04 knowledge-path, system-subject, and write-capable-read hardening
C11 first-use initialization and reviewed payload refresh
known_confounders: PBI 0 and 1 used a free model, so their cost is unavailable and not comparable with paid runs.
PBI 1's session window includes a long blocked interval and is not active-work time.
PBI 3 and 4 had a prompt-ordering deviation: the log was written before checkpoint disposition by explicit instruction.
PBI 4 deferred the conversation edit form; comparison should use the stated scope, not the full PBI text.
No same-task plain-Pi baseline exists for this round.
PBI 5 was interrupted by a laptop crash and resumed; its window includes that interruption.

next_round.purpose: Repeat the same PBI sequence after calibration/backlog changes; compare like-for-like metrics under declared model phases.

measurement_questions: Did each PBI produce working, verified application changes?
Where did governance gates add friction, and were any blocks wrong?
Did retrieval fire, return applicable records, and change behaviour?
Which facts were staged/promoted, and were promotions explicitly reviewed?
What tool/token/cost overhead occurred under a known model phase?

model_phase_policy.principle: Provider/model is a per-run covariate, not a controlled constant.
model_phase_policy.rule: Compare cost only within a declared model phase. New model switches add a new phase label, not a new experiment.

provider_boundary.summary: Model-agnostic metadata contract: optional provider/model identifiers and token counts; local latency; no credentials, network, live provider, raw content, or billing semantics.
provider_boundary.live_provider: requires separate PBI and explicit provider/privacy/cost approval
